top_signals.title: India’s Small Traders Lose $9.6 Billion in Derivatives
top_signals.summary: Individuals in India lost 916.85 billion rupees ($9.6 billion) buying and selling equity futures and options in the year ended March, down from 1.1 trillion rupees a year earlier, the government told lawmakers on Tuesday.
